parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for descending. Allowed: id, sku, name, type, barcode, mpn, unit_cost, average_cost, supplier_price, weight, length, width, height, case_quantity, case_weight, daily_average_consumption, daily_average_consumption_net_returns, min_stock_level, total_quantity_sold, total_orders, archived_at, created_at, updated_at

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Full-text search across ID (exact), SKU, name, barcode, MPN, and brand name

parameters.name: filter[type]
parameters.description: Exact product type: standard, bundle, kit, blemished, matrix

parameters.name: filter[archived]
parameters.description: Archived state: 0 or omit for active only, 'only' for archived only, 'all' for all

parameters.name: filter[default_supplier_id]
parameters.description: Filter by default supplier ID(s), comma-separated

parameters.name: filter[has_backorder]
parameters.description: Filter by backorder presence: true or false

parameters.name: filter[has_fba]
parameters.description: Filter by FBA listing presence: true or false

parameters.name: filter[ids]
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of product IDs to include

parameters.name: filter_groups
parameters.description: Advanced grouped filter tree (JSON). Columns: sku, name, barcode, mpn, type, unit_cost, average_cost, brand_name, supplier_name, supplier_sku, tag, category, inventory_total, inventory_available, etc.

parameters.name: filter[date_of_return.after]
parameters.description: Date of Return filter. EXISTS filter — matches products that have a return receipt (returnReceiptLines.returnReceipt.received_at) in the range. Replace '.after' with any operator: is, is_not, before, after, on_or_before, on_or_after, between, is_empty, is_not_empty, today, yesterday, tomorrow, past_week, past_month, past_year, next_week, next_month, next_year, days_ago, days_from_now, past_days, next_days. For 'between' pass filter[date_of_return.between]=2025-06-01,2025-06-30. The bare filter[date_of_return] form acts as 'is'.

parameters.name: filter[date_of_sales_credit.after]
parameters.description: Date of Sales Credit filter. EXISTS filter — matches products that have a sales credit (salesCreditLines.salesCredit.credit_date) in the range. Replace '.after' with any operator: is, is_not, before, after, on_or_before, on_or_after, between, is_empty, is_not_empty, today, yesterday, tomorrow, past_week, past_month, past_year, next_week, next_month, next_year, days_ago, days_from_now, past_days, next_days. For 'between' pass filter[date_of_sales_credit.between]=2025-06-01,2025-06-30. The bare filter[date_of_sales_credit] form acts as 'is'.

parameters.name: filter[total_quantity_sold.greater_than]
parameters.description: Total units ever sold (sum of non-draft, non-cancelled sales order line quantities). Numeric filter — replace '.greater_than' with any operator: equals, not_equals, greater_than, greater_than_or_equal, less_than, less_than_or_equal, between (filter[total_quantity_sold.between]=50,200), is_empty, is_not_empty.

parameters.name: filter[total_orders.greater_than]
parameters.description: Count of distinct non-draft, non-cancelled sales orders that include the product. Numeric filter — replace '.greater_than' with any operator: equals, not_equals, greater_than, greater_than_or_equal, less_than, less_than_or_equal, between (filter[total_orders.between]=3,10), is_empty, is_not_empty.
